summary: Travelers Companies, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement to issue $750 million aggregate principal amount of 4.950% Senior Notes due 2031. The underwriters include Barclays Capital Inc., BofA Securities, Inc., Citigroup Global Markets Inc., J.P. Morgan Securities LLC and Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation such as a merger, restructuring or activist campaign. The prospectus supplement was filed separately. No premium, tender offer or strategic change is involved. The filing merely satisfies disclosure obligations for a public debt offering, with no risk-arb or event-driven angle.
